title: 相干光接收器整合
summary: 從光混頻、平衡偵測與光電共同設計拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate optical mixing, balanced detection and optoelectronic co-design, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 訊號與本振
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「訊號與本振」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Signal and local oscillator through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 相干接收邊界：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「相干接收邊界」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for coherent-receiver boundary, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「相干接收邊界」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。相干接收用本振將訊號場轉成可量測差頻，不是只量總光功率。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「畫訊號、本振與 I/Q 輸出，標出頻率差與相位。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for coherent-receiver boundary, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Coherent reception mixes signal and LO fields into measurable beat signals, not only total power. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Draw signal, LO and I/Q outputs, marking frequency difference and phase. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 畫訊號、本振與 I/Q 輸出，標出頻率差與相位。
steps.observationEn: Draw signal, LO and I/Q outputs, marking frequency difference and phase.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：本振功率越大永遠越好。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: More LO power is always better. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交相干接收邊界的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「畫訊號、本振與 I/Q 輸出，標出頻率差與相位。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for coherent-receiver boundary, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Draw signal, LO and I/Q outputs, marking frequency difference and phase.

steps.title: 相干接收邊界：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「相干接收邊界」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for coherent-receiver boundary, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。畫訊號、本振與 I/Q 輸出，標出頻率差與相位。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「相干接收用本振將訊號場轉成可量測差頻，不是只量總光功率。」與錯誤假說「相同 OSNR 對所有調變有相同 BER。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Draw signal, LO and I/Q outputs, marking frequency difference and phase. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Coherent reception mixes signal and LO fields into measurable beat signals, not only total power." against the incorrect hypothesis "Equal OSNR gives equal BER for every format."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 畫訊號、本振與 I/Q 輸出，標出頻率差與相位。

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Equal OSNR gives equal BER for every format. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交相干接收邊界的量測判別表：畫訊號、本振與 I/Q 輸出，標出頻率差與相位。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for balanced photocurrent, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Ideal balanced detection cancels common DC terms while retaining the beat cross term. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Check responsivity, mW-to-W conversion and branch-current signs in the example. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume inputs of one ideal 50:50 balanced mixer, after any I/Q branch splitting: Ps=0.01 mW, Plo=1 mW and responsivity R=0.8 A/W. Differential beat amplitude i=2R√(PsPlo)=0.16 mA. These are not total powers before a full 90-degree hybrid splits them.

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。按算例核對響應度、mW 轉 W 及兩支路電流方向。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「理想平衡偵測抵銷共同直流項並保留拍頻交叉項。」與錯誤假說「本振功率越大永遠越好。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假設單一 50:50 平衡混頻器的入口功率（已扣除 I/Q 分支分光）為 Ps=0.01 mW、Plo=1 mW，響應度 R=0.8 A/W；差動拍頻峰值 i=2R√(PsPlo)=0.16 mA。Ps、Plo 並非整個 90° 混合器分光前的總功率。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Check responsivity, mW-to-W conversion and branch-current signs in the example. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Ideal balanced detection cancels common DC terms while retaining the beat cross term." against the incorrect hypothesis "More LO power is always better."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume inputs of one ideal 50:50 balanced mixer, after any I/Q branch splitting: Ps=0.01 mW, Plo=1 mW and responsivity R=0.8 A/W. Differential beat amplitude i=2R√(PsPlo)=0.16 mA. These are not total powers before a full 90-degree hybrid splits them.
steps.observation: 按算例核對響應度、mW 轉 W 及兩支路電流方向。
steps.observationEn: Check responsivity, mW-to-W conversion and branch-current signs in the example.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：本振功率越大永遠越好。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: More LO power is always better. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交平衡光電流的量測判別表：按算例核對響應度、mW 轉 W 及兩支路電流方向。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for balanced photocurrent: Check responsivity, mW-to-W conversion and branch-current signs in the example. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

knowledge.text: 理想平衡偵測抵銷共同直流項並保留拍頻交叉項。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal balanced detection cancels common DC terms while retaining the beat cross term.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 按算例核對響應度、mW 轉 W 及兩支路電流方向。
knowledge.textEn: Check responsivity, mW-to-W conversion and branch-current signs in the example.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 拍頻項正比 √(PsPlo)，量測須明確指定混合器端口功率。 理想匹配、無飽和、未含散粒與 TIA 噪聲；非靈敏度保證。
knowledge.textEn: The beat term scales with √(PsPlo); explicitly define hybrid-port powers. Ideal matching without saturation, shot noise or TIA noise; not a sensitivity guarantee.

quiz.question: 要審查「平衡光電流」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing balanced photocurrent?
